analysis_status: Frozen before the full simulation was run.
purpose: Compare simple-random and subgroup-stratified target audits for a registered rare-group risk requirement.

subgroup_audit.primary_error_outcome: Familywise probability of validating at least one boundary-invalid candidate.
subgroup_audit.primary_power_outcome: Fraction of valid candidates validated for the subgroup-specific requirement.
subgroup_audit.sampling_interpretation: The stratified design fixes the number of labeled rare-group records. It does not count the additional screening effort needed to find those records.
